title: Grandma’s measurements

caption:
A pinch. A handful. “You’ll know when it’s ready.”

Next time you cook together, ask if you can record the little details the recipe leaves out. Save the story behind the dish with your family’s memories in Everlittle.

title: Ask a better question
hook: “Tell me about your life” is a big question.
angle: Specific prompts reduce the effort of starting

slides.title:
“Tell me about your life”
is a big question.
slides.body: Start with one of these instead.
slides.label: START SMALL

slides.title:
What did home
sound like?
slides.body: The radio in the kitchen. A familiar voice. The street outside.
slides.label: 01 / THE EVERYDAY

slides.title:
Who taught you
your favourite recipe?
slides.body: Then ask: what do you do differently now?
slides.label: 02 / THE HAND-ME-DOWN

slides.title:
What made you laugh
when you were my age?
slides.body: Leave room for the detour. That may be the best part.
slides.label: 03 / THE SURPRISE

slides.title:
One question.
One voice.
A little more of them.
slides.body: Ask before recording. Keep their story with your family’s memories in Everlittle.
slides.label: SAVE FOR YOUR NEXT CALL

caption:
You don’t need to interview a whole lifetime. Start with one small question and follow the story.

Save these prompts for your next call. Ask permission before recording, then keep the memory with your family in Everlittle. Link in bio.

#Everlittle #FamilyMemories #MemoryKeeping
alt: Ask a better question — five cream and ink prompt cards.

title: Your first letter in three sentences
hook: A letter to your child can start with three sentences.

slides.title:
A letter to your child
can start with
three sentences.
slides.body: No grand speech required.
slides.label: LETTERS FOR LATER

slides.title: “Right now, you…”
slides.body: Keep one tiny detail: a favourite phrase, a small habit, the way they greet you.
slides.label: 01 / NOTICE

slides.title: “Today, I loved…”
slides.body: Choose one moment. The smaller and more specific, the more it feels like them.
slides.label: 02 / REMEMBER

slides.title: “I hope you know…”
slides.body: Finish with something you want them to carry into the future.
slides.label: 03 / SAY IT

slides.title:
That’s enough
for a first letter.
slides.body: Save it in an Everlittle time capsule for a date in their future. Link in bio.
slides.label: SAVE THIS STARTING POINT

caption:
A letter doesn’t need to sum up everything you feel. These three starts are enough for today.

Save this template. Write one small letter, then keep it in an Everlittle time capsule for a future date. Link in bio.

#Everlittle #FamilyMemories #MemoryKeeping
alt: Your first letter in three sentences — five cream and ink prompt cards.

title: The photo needs one sentence
hook: A photo shows what happened. A sentence saves what it meant.

slides.title:
A photo shows
what happened.
slides.body: A sentence saves what it meant.
slides.label: KEEP A LITTLE MORE

slides.title:
The photo:
a pair of muddy shoes.
slides.body: The story: “You jumped into every puddle because you thought they were little oceans.”
slides.label: AN EXAMPLE

slides.title:
The photo:
a kitchen table.
slides.body: The story: “This was where Grandpa taught you his very questionable card tricks.”
slides.label: AN EXAMPLE

slides.title:
Try this after
your next photo.
slides.body:
“I want to remember this because…”
Finish the sentence. That’s the story.
slides.label: YOUR TURN

slides.title:
Keep the photo.
Keep the why.
slides.body: Add the little story beside it in Everlittle. Link in bio.
slides.label: SAVE THIS PROMPT

caption:
Future you might remember the place and still forget the joke.

Add one sentence to a photo today: “I want to remember this because…” Keep both together in Everlittle.

The examples in these slides are illustrative. What story would you add to your latest photo?

title: Seven ordinary things
hook: Seven things worth saving before they become “remember when?”

slides.title:
7 things worth saving

slides.title:

slides.title: Pick one today.
slides.body: A photo, a voice note or a few lines. Keep it with your family in Everlittle.
slides.label: SAVE THE LIST

caption:
You don’t need to collect everything. Start with one ordinary thing from this list.

Save it for the days when “I should write that down” turns into “What was it again?”

Everlittle keeps your family’s photos, voices, stories and letters together. Link in bio.
